sections.Profile:
"Touch" is a pinball machine released by the Spanish manufacturer Inder in 1973. This electro-mechanical game accommodates a single player and features two flippers, three pop bumpers, four mushroom bumpers, two slingshots, eight standup targets, and five kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Inder
- Years made: 1973
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Horses, Original Theme, Horse Racing, 1970s
